changes: Removed mutable last-write time as entropy admission authority.
Added exact held full-file streaming through 8 MiB and identity-keyed unpredictable multi-range proofs above that bound.
Bound offsets, lengths, bytes, digest, identity, size, generation and ancestry through publication.
Added a 64 MiB per-root read budget with explicit incomplete/exhausted coverage and non-green health.

assurance_boundary: Large files use representative ranges and are therefore explicitly incomplete below health 100; authenticated local receipts do not replace a current held reread.

changes: Added authenticated durable pending-loss, refusal, continuity-loss, alias, topology and two-phase eviction events.
Reconstructs latched degradation, loss, aliases, topology uncertainty, refusals, evictions and pending transitions across restart.
Added a separately keyed local high-water witness outside the create-on-missing custody bundle.
Rejects partial/main authority deletion and paired database/head rollback behind the enrolled witness.
Reserves and exposes terminal ledger capacity before capture and source retirement.
Performs full digest/link reconciliation at publication and permanently discloses the unavoidable userspace hard-link topology race.
assurance_boundary: The local witness detects ordinary bundle deletion and paired rollback but is not a TPM/remote monotonic authority; clean local custody is intentionally capped below health 100.
